name: tabs
description: Peer panes. The selected tab is a heading TalkBack can jump to.
avoidWhen: Do not use for filters on one list; use chip or segmented-control. Do not swipe pages inside this item.

ux.behaviour: The selected tab is marked as a heading
ux.why: TalkBack can jump to the pane you are in

ux.behaviour: Changing tabs fires a tick haptic
ux.why: A new pane should feel landed

aiHints: Own selectedIndex; render the pane yourself below the tabs
Do not put actions in the tab row
